chunks: Ribʿī ibn ʿAbdillāh and Fuḍayl ibn Yasār narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
There is no Jumuʿah, nor Eid al-Fitr, nor Eid al-Adha in travel.

key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel; the state of journeying that affects certain legal rulings
key_terms.لَيْسَ: indicates negation of obligation or applicability in this context

ai.seo_question: Are Jumuʿah and Eid prayers obligatory for a traveler in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that the Friday prayer and the Eid prayers of al-Fitr and al-Adha are not observed by the traveler. It is a concise jurisprudential text concerning exemptions related to acts of worship during السفر.
